Job Title: .NET/D365 Software Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: None 
 
Type of Travel: None 
 
 
* * * 
 
 The Opportunity: 
This position will work in CACI’s corporate information systems organization. As a Microsoft Dynamics Developer, you will be a key contributing member in ensuring corporate information systems IT projects are architected and developed with a high degree of quality. The ideal candidate will have enough experience to influence and design solutions. This is one project team in a larger department supporting multiple internal business systems. You will have exposure to a wide variety of functional areas and may help to troubleshoot other areas as data is passed among them. 

 Responsibilities: 

 Configure within the D365 system, including entities, forms, views, workflows, navigation, and other usability elements.
 Work within the Azure Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI) to provide automation, reporting, and integration.
 Create custom plug-ins using C#.
 Work with custom coded integrations between our Dynamics environment and other on-premise systems, 3rd party sites, etc.
 Participate on a new initiative to implement Microsoft Dynamics applications, integrations and reports across the CACI enterprise of 20,000+ employees.
 Become part of an enterprise business system team comprised of 40+ developers, architects and business analysts.
 Interact with functional stakeholders and vendors on a frequent basis.
 Participate in other projects leveraging your development skills.

 Qualifications: 
 Required:  

 Requires bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and minimum 5 years of related work experience, to include at least 2 years of experience in MS Dynamics 365.
 Experience in development/configuration of the Dynamics platform, including fields, entities, workflows, business process, etc.
 Experience with Power Automate Flows, canvas apps, and custom plugins
 Experience with Java Script
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 Must be experienced in custom development in Microsoft Dynamics
 Dynamics experience should include front end configurations using the Extensibility Framework as well as integration development using Dynamics API’s
 Proficient in both front-end web development as well as back end console application development using .NET/C#.
 Must have the ability to learn new functional areas quickly.
 Must have the ability to debug / trace code and resolve issues quickly.
 Must be a U.S. citizen.

 Desired: 

 SharePoint configuration/development
 Boomi development
 SQL
 Experience working with API's
 Experience with back office systems (i.e., Accounting, Contracts, HR, etc.) for a Government Contractor.
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$67,800 - $142,200 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
